_comment: User-verified career Oscar-win totals (per person) that override whatever source_data/Movie_DB.xlsx's 'Director Oscar Wins' column says for that row, applied by scripts/build_cards.py. Added 2026-09-04 after a consistency check found the xlsx disagreeing with itself across a director's own films (e.g. Coppola listed as 5/5/4). For a card credited to multiple people, the MAX of the listed people's totals is used (the more Oscar-decorated of the pair) when at least one of them has an override; a co-director not in this file doesn't block the other's override from applying.
